messages:
kai: dropped a small design pass in figma: focused on compare table column pinning, compact filter chips, performance badge thresholds, and pin microcopy. link: https://www.figma.com/file/qw12/model-catalog-layout

ren: skimmed. big question: when you pin a column in compare should it be sticky horizontally or do we duplicate the pinned column as a frozen column? both have tradeoffs for keyboard nav.

harper: prefer frozen column (like spreadsheet freeze) because it preserves relative scroll positions for other columns. easier for keyboard users.

kai: good point. UX trade: frozen column increases layout complexity when window shrinks. idea: freeze only up to two columns, beyond that show a pinned summary pill at left.

marc: microcopy around pin: users confuse pin/persist. Proposal: primary label: "Pin version" tooltip secondary line: "Overrides route-level rollouts". alt language: "Freeze version (overrides routing)". Which is less ambiguous?

prieto: from support logs, "pin" is used in user questions more often than "freeze". i'd test both but default to "Pin version" with a short helper link to docs.

ren: accessibility: frozen column should be reachable via landmark or skip link. also add aria-describedby on the pin control that points to the helper text.

harper: performance badge thresholds: current badge shows a colored dot based on median. we should use 95th or 98th percentile for tail latency. proposal: badge color = green if p95 < 200ms, amber if 200-500ms, red if >500ms. also show exact percentile in aria-label.

marc: add a small tooltip with two lines: "p95: 180ms" and "tokens/s: 24". keep icon as a tiny sparkline. prefer using semantic color tokens: --perf-good, --perf-ok, --perf-bad.

kai: small design for chips: show up to 3 overlapping avatars on chips, collapse to "+N" at <340px. hover/focus opens a small preview. chips remain interactive buttons (aria-pressed on toggle state).

ren: CSS snippet for avatar overlap I'd use:

```
.chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; }
.chip .avatar { width:16px; height:16px; border-radius:50%; margin-left:-6px; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--card-bg); }
```

harper: keyboard note: ensure avatars inside chips are not separate tab stops; the chip is a single button. use aria-hidden on decorative avatars and provide aria-label for comment count like "3 comments on this filter".

prieto: analytics: add events: catalog.pin_clicked, catalog.pin_tooltip_shown, catalog.chip_preview_open. include properties: model_id, version_id, route_id, user_tier.

marc: a11y/color: current green (#22c55e) fails for 12px text on light bg. use #15803d or add a subtle 1px border to meet 4.5:1. i'll run a contrast sweep.

kai: about the frozen column UX: when a user pins a version show a transient toast: "Pinned version X for this route 1 link: View routing docs" and include an undo action. toast should be aria-live=polite.

ren: tests: keyboard nav through frozen column, screen reader narration when pin applied, contrast checks, and small screen collapse of avatars. can we put behind flag?

kai: yes. ship behind feature flag and gate analytics. timeline: design sign-off by Thu, dev prototype Fri, ship behind flag next Wed.

devops-bot: Build queued for branch feature/compare-freeze-and-chip-avatars (id: 1402) 3 running unit + a11y checks. :gear:

harper: small copy tweak for empty compare: current "No models selected" -> "No models selected  Choose models or pin a version to compare." keeps it action-oriented.

prieto: i'll author the A/B config for pin wording: variant A = "Pin version" variant B = "Freeze version" with 5% each. we'll monitor help center hits and pin-related tickets.

kai: thanks team 1 i'll post final figma frames and the annotated a11y checklist after sign-off.
